description: Answers recorded from the fare-policy-assistant pipeline on 2026-06-16 against corpus version 10deac978967, with the published fare documents they were retrieved from. Reshaped from evals/govchat/golden.jsonl by evals/plumbline_export.py; no model was called to produce this bundle. Source text remains the copyright of the respective transit agency (see corpus/LICENSE-NOTE.md); it is reproduced here as short excerpts for evaluation, not licensed for redistribution.
name: fare-policy-assistant

prompt_versions.answer_user: v7 2026-07-11 (v6 bound proof/contact details to the exact class/product; v7 adds the canonical Tagalog snapshot-date disclosure)
prompt_versions.system: v22 2026-08-16 (v10 requires the exact published criterion before process details on attribute-based eligibility questions and adds explicit Tagalog language/date guidance; v11 names all nine corpus agencies and replaces the stale count with "the agencies listed above"; v12 added County Connection (CCCTA) as the tenth corpus agency; v13 added San Joaquin RTD (SJRTD) as the eleventh; v14 added AC Transit as the twelfth; v15 added WestCAT as the thirteenth; v16 added SLO RTA as the fourteenth; v17 added VTA as the fifteenth; v18 added Napa Valley Vine Transit (VINE) as the sixteenth; v19 added SamTrans as the seventeenth; v20 adds Marin Transit as the eighteenth — tests/test_prompt_agencies.py fails a corpus agency the prompt does not name, so each lands with its corpus PR; targets the marin-* cases, none yet scored live; v21 binds every application/proof detail to the rider class the passages attach it to and drops the "apply for an MST Courtesy Card" worked example that taught the model to transplant the veteran issuance route onto a senior, live-validated on the 26-case smoke suite 2026-08-16, 26/26 with judges running — answer claude-haiku-4-5, judge claude-sonnet-4-6, corpus 3dd8b7bd757e; the same suite was 24/26 under v20 that morning, with refuse-025 and fresh-001 the two failures. v22 2026-08-16 answers what the first full live run of the eighteen-agency corpus found. That run (385 cases, judges running, answer claude-haiku-4-5, judge claude-sonnet-4-6, corpus 3dd8b7bd757e) scored the multi-agency claim for the first time and it did not hold: cross_agency 4/21, against 3/3 on the three cases that suite held in July. The marin-* cases are no longer unscored — 12 of them ran, 8 passed, and xagency-marin-001 was not one of them. The dominant model-side failure across every suite was abstention, not invention: 29 cases were failed for reporting that the passages are silent on a fact the retrieved passages state, most often the second agency in a two-agency question. v22 adds no new latitude — the rider-class binding above is unchanged and tests/test_cross_class_pathway.py still guards it — and instead closes two gaps: rule 1 now says the silence disclaimer must be true before it is used, and a new rule 7 covers multi-agency questions, which eighteen agencies of corpus had never had a rule for. Separately, 42 of the 385 cases could not be scored at all: infra/deploy.sh disables yolobus-fares by default because the committed Yolobus fare period ended 2026-06-30, and the eval now runs under the exact Lambda environment, so those cases hit the containment refusal rather than the assistant. They are reported as not applicable, not as failures)
